VMSections.title: Vision
VMSections.description: We envision a safe environment and protection against sexual harassment of women and men and to ensure gender equality.

VMSections.title: Mission
ListPoints: To provide a secure environment – free of gender-based discrimination.
To ensure equal access to all facilities and participation in activities of the college.
Prevention and redressal of sexual harassment cases and other acts of gender-based violence in the institution.
Implementation of the policy in letter and spirit through proper reporting of the complaints and their follow-up procedures.

AccordionSections.title: Objectives
points:
To raise awareness about sexual harassment and its effects
To prevent and address incidents of sexual harassment.
Creating a safe and supportive environment for students and employees.

AccordionSections.title: Functions
points: Receive and register complaints of sexual harassment, if any.
Provide a confidential platform for individuals to report incidents.
Provide emotional and psychological support to victims of sexual harassment.
Conduct workshops, seminars, and campaigns to raise awareness about sexual harassment.
